flags.text: Profit compounding faster than sales over 3y (213.2% vs -1.0%): operating leverage
Operating margin down 300 bps over 3 years
Cash conversion strong: 5y operating cash = 145% of profit

guidance.promise: FY26 EBIT to be in the range of 0% to 2% positive
guidance.quote: For the full year, we expect EBIT to be in the range of 0% to 2% positive, and free cash flow to be in a range of negative GBP 2.2 billion to negative GBP 2.5 billion.
guidance.speaker: Richard Molyneux

guidance.promise: FY26 free cash flow in a range of negative GBP 2.2 billion to negative GBP 2.5 billion
guidance.quote: For the full year, we expect EBIT to be in the range of 0% to 2% positive, and free cash flow to be in a range of negative GBP 2.2 billion to negative GBP 2.5 billion.
guidance.speaker: Richard Molyneux

claims.claim: JLR Q2 revenues dropped 24% due to production loss from cyber incident.
claims.quote: With the loss of production for the entire month of September due to the cyber incident, the JLR revenues dropped by 24%

claims.claim: India domestic PV volumes grew 10% year-on-year for the quarter.
claims.quote: After a particularly weak Q1, the domestic PV business has seen a strong rebound in Q2. Volumes grew 10% year-on-year for the quarter.

claims.claim: Recorded a notional profit of ~Rs. 83,000 Cr on disposal of the CV undertaking.
claims.quote: we have recorded a profit of ~Rs. 83,000 Cr on disposal of the CV undertaking, which is essentially the fair value of the CV assets, less the book value of net assets transferred.

claims.claim: Full year FY25 PLI of Rs. 350 Cr received in cash from MHI this quarter.
claims.quote: I must also add that the PLI accrued for the full year FY 25 of Rs. 350 Cr has now been received in cash from MHI this quarter.

pushback.topic: JLR margin guidance and cyber impact
pushback.quote: What is the Q3 build rate and can the management please guide on the full year volume range on which you're basing your margin guidance? And have the full cyber costs have been taken or more to come in Q3?

pushback.topic: U.S. tariffs and China luxury tax impact on margins
pushback.quote: Do you think the U.S. tariff and China luxury tax has structurally brought down margins outlook?

pushback.topic: India PV realizations and discount trends
pushback.quote: Why was India PV realization down despite rising share of EV and CNG? What's your estimate for second half volume growth for industry and TMPV and how are discounts shaping up post festive?

calls.tone: Prankly transparent about operational challenges from cyber incidents and market headwinds while highlighting domestic resilience.

guidance.promise: Reconfirming guidance of greater than 0% EBIT for the balance of the year
guidance.quote: we are reconﬁrming our guidance of greater than 0% EBIT
guidance.speaker: Richard Molyneux

guidance.promise: Free cash flow in the range of negative GBP 2.2 billion to negative GBP 2.5 billion for the year
guidance.quote: free cash ﬂow in the range of negative GBP 2.2 billion to negative GBP 2.5 billion.
guidance.speaker: Richard Molyneux

guidance.promise: Capex guidance will be GBP 3.6 billion to GBP 3.7 billion
guidance.quote: Capex guidance, I think, will be GBP 3.6 billion, GBP 3.7 billion from what I can see today.
guidance.speaker: Richard Molyneux

guidance.promise: End the year around Rs 4,200 Cr to Rs 4,300 Cr for total Capex investments
guidance.quote: We expect to end the year somewhere around Rs. 4,200 Cr to Rs. 4,300 Cr for the full year.
guidance.speaker: Dhiman Gupta

claims.claim: Consolidated revenue came in at approximately Rs 70,000 Cr, down 26% year-on-year
claims.quote: Consolidated revenue came in at ~Rs. 70,000 Cr, 26% down year-on-year

claims.claim: Crossed 2.5 lakh EVs on road in the domestic business
claims.quote: We also crossed 2.5 lakh EVs on road, that's another milestone.

claims.claim: Sierra secured 70,000 bookings on the first day
claims.quote: It secured 70,000 bookings on the ﬁrst day and continues to see strong booking momentum.

claims.claim: Achieved all-time high monthly sales of 71,000 units in January 2026
claims.quote: we achieved all-time high monthly sales of 71,000 units, reﬂecting a 47% year-on-year increase.

pushback.topic: JLR cash breakeven and net cash timeline
pushback.quote: where is the breakeven in FCF for JLR in terms of wholesales per year? I believe it used to be around 325,000 units per year. Is that the case? How is your order book at the end of Q3?

pushback.topic: JLR gross margins and VME increase
pushback.quote: JLR gross margins can you please explain the sharp improvement quarter-on-quarter, even high VME, what is the outlook on account of commodities and semiconductor prices?

pushback.topic: China luxury market competition and debt recovery
pushback.quote: How do you see increasing competition from local brands in the luxury car segment? JLR debt has increased substantially due to operational disruptions. Do you expect to go back to net cash position in the next two-three quarters?

calls.tone: Cautious yet resilient, addressing severe cyber and tariff headwinds while highlighting strong domestic recovery.

guidance.promise: Deliver GBP1.7 billion of savings over two years to bring breakeven volume down towards 300,000 units a year
guidance.quote: Together, we're targeting GBP1.7 billion of savings over two years to bring our breakeven volume back down towards 300,000 units a year.
guidance.speaker: Richard Molyneux

guidance.promise: Target 70% to 100% export growth in FY27 depending on production ramp-up
guidance.quote: And this year also, we are targeting anywhere between 70% to 100% kind of a growth, depending on how we are able to ramp up our production
guidance.speaker: Shailesh Chandra

guidance.promise: Industry to grow around 10% in FY27
guidance.quote: industry will grow very strong, and I am pegging the number around 10%
guidance.speaker: Shailesh Chandra

claims.claim: Consolidated revenue reached ~Rs. 105,000 Cr for the quarter, up 7% year-on-year
claims.quote: Revenue comes in at ~Rs. 105,000 Cr for the quarter, up 7% year-on-year on the back of strong India growth story and the currency appreciation.

claims.claim: PV business FCF for the quarter came in at about Rs. 1,700 Cr
claims.quote: FCF for the quarter came in at about Rs. 1,700 Cr, both from strong operating profits, favorable working capital, and we also had about Rs. 500 Cr benefit of tax refunds

claims.claim: Full year FY26 JLR wholesales achieved 308,000 units
claims.quote: On a full year basis, on the bottom row, we achieved 308,000 wholesales with again, Defender, Range Rover and Range Rover Sport showing the strongest performance.

claims.claim: TMPV closed FY26 with a record 6.42 lakh units, delivering over 15% growth year-on-year
claims.quote: We closed the year at a record 6.42 lakh units, delivering over 15% growth year-on-year, nearly twice the pace of the broader industry

pushback.topic: Commodity headwinds and price increase plans
pushback.quote: Could you give us a sense of what is the kind of commodity headwind that we have seen and we are likely to see and how we are thinking of passing it on?

pushback.topic: JLR ASPs and gross margins trending down
pushback.quote: JLR ASPs trended down quarter-on-quarter, while the share of RR and Defender went up. If you could talk us through this. Also the gross margins went down quarter-on-quarter.

pushback.topic: EV demand, profitability, and Middle East crisis impact
pushback.quote: India EVs, can you talk about the demand environment? And how long-term are you thinking of EV profitability versus ICE?

calls.tone: Prudent and confident, addressing structural and geopolitical headwinds while emphasizing strong operational recovery and cost-out missions.

guidance.promise: Targeting 12,000 cars this year on the EV space for FY27
guidance.quote: and therefore, as far as FY 27 is concerned, basis the production start that is planned, I think we are tentatively penciling about 12,000 cars this year on the EV space.
guidance.speaker: PB Balaji

guidance.promise: Setting a goal of 10% revenue growth per annum
guidance.quote: So we are setting a goal of 10% revenue growth per annum and focusing on the US market for a significant part of that.
guidance.speaker: Richard Molyneux

guidance.promise: Save $1.7 billion in ex-works cost, warranty, and fixed cost base
guidance.quote: On costs, our focus is the ex-works cost of our cars, warranty, and our fixed cost base. And our intent is to save $1.7 billion in this space.
guidance.speaker: Richard Molyneux

guidance.promise: Formal and definitive agreement with Stellantis by end of year
guidance.quote: We signed an MoU a couple of months ago. We are aiming to get that to a formal and definitive agreement by the end of the year.
guidance.speaker: Richard Molyneux

guidance.quote: And that is going to delay the project a bit, but in 2027, we should be able to launch the product.
guidance.speaker: Shailesh Chandra

claims.claim: TMPV delivered revenues of Rs. 95,800 Cr with 2.4% EBIT margins and Rs. 1,600 Cr PBT.
claims.quote: TMPV delivered revenues of Rs. 95,800 Cr for the quarter, EBIT margins at 2.4%, and PBT for the quarter stood at Rs. 1,600 Cr, down on a year-on-year basis.

claims.claim: India business revenues grew 65% year-on-year to Rs. 18,000 crores.
claims.quote: India business revenues at Rs.18,000 crores, grew 65% year-on-year, but the gains were nearly entirely offset by the steep commodity increases

claims.claim: Delivered highest-ever EV volumes of over 34,000 units in the quarter.
claims.quote: Coming to our EV performance, we delivered our highest-ever volumes of over 34,000 units in the quarter and sustained market leadership position.

claims.claim: JLR wholesales were down 10% year-over-year with revenue of GBP 6 billion.
claims.quote: Wholesales were down about 10% year-over-year... This drove revenue to GBP 6 billion with EBIT of 2.8%, a positive PBT of GBP 109 million

pushback.topic: Price increase sensitivity versus raw material costs
pushback.quote: Despite such strong raw material headwinds, we've only taken a 1% price increase. Do you believe that customers are, what do you see the price sensitivity that customers had despite demand being so strong?

pushback.topic: JLR guidance and North America production localization
pushback.quote: Has the JLR FY 27 guidance been dropped or does it still stand? And with the focus on North America, do you intend to localize some production or do we assume lower margins on any incremental volumes that you sell through?

pushback.topic: Credit ratings and debt levels at JLR
pushback.quote: what is the view that the credit rating agencies have on the credit rating, and what's the linkage to the overall cost of debt at JLR?

calls.tone: Cautiously optimistic, transparent about operational headwinds, and focused on cost actions and upcoming product launches.

promise_ledger.delivered: Reported Jun 2026 revenue was 95799.0 crore, representing a 9.3% YoY growth, falling short of the 10% annual goal.
promise_ledger.quote: So we are setting a goal of 10% revenue growth per annum and focusing on the US market for a significant part of that.

credibility.line: Management missed major FY26 guidance targets for EBIT and free cash flow and missed the Q1 FY27 revenue growth goal.

narrative_vs_numbers.point: Management claimed consolidated revenue reached ~Rs. 105,000 Cr in Q4 FY26, whereas reported revenue was 105447.0 crore.
Management guided for positive FY26 EBIT of 0% to 2%, but reported Mar 2026 full-year EBITDA was 18719.0 crore (6.0%).
Management claimed JLR revenue of GBP 6 billion in Q1 FY27, while reported company revenue was 95799.0 crore rupees.

bull: Operating cash flow was 13041.0 crore for the year ended Mar 2026.
Reported Jun 2026 revenue grew 9.3% year-on-year to 95799.0 crore.
Debt-to-equity improved to 0.71 as of Mar 2026 compared to 1.26 in Mar 2024.
bear: Free cash flow for the year ended Mar 2026 was negative 23195.0 crore.
Operating margin decreased by 300 bps over 3 years.
EBIT% dropped to 1.4% in Jun 2026 compared to 3.8% in Jun 2025.
